en.title: The Eroding Coordinates and the Rainfall Singularity
en.premise: A 'Tuner' tasked with repairing malfunctions in weather control encounters a mysterious old bookstore that manifests only when spatial phases overlap under specific rainfall conditions. The worn coordinates handed to them by the shopkeeper point toward the entrance of the 'Calculation City' submerged in the ultra-deep sea—a massive biological computer abandoned by humanity, built to redefine the very laws of physics.

zh.title: 被侵蚀的坐标与降雨奇点
zh.premise: 主角是一名负责修复气象控制故障的“调律师”。在特定的降雨条件下，他偶遇了一家仅在空间相位重叠时才会出现的神秘古书店。店主交给他的陈旧坐标，指向了沉没在超深海中的“演算都市”入口。那里是人类曾经抛弃的、为了重新定义物理法则而存在的巨大生物计算机。
